name: noteskin-screen-globals
lua_assertions:
local self = native_target
SCREEN_WIDTH=640; SCREEN_HEIGHT=480; SCREEN_LEFT=0; SCREEN_TOP=0; SCREEN_RIGHT=SCREEN_WIDTH; SCREEN_BOTTOM=SCREEN_HEIGHT; SCREEN_CENTER_X=320; SCREEN_CENTER_Y=240
self:finishtweening():xy(0,0):z(0):rotationx(0):rotationy(0):rotationz(0):zoom(1):valign(0.5)
self:valign(1):zoomy(SCREEN_HEIGHT):addrotationz(180)
assert(self:GetZoomX() == 1, "case 0: GetZoomX")
assert(self:GetZoomY() == 480, "case 0: GetZoomY")
assert(self:GetZoomZ() == 1, "case 0: GetZoomZ")
assert(self:GetX() == 0, "case 0: GetX")
assert(self:GetY() == 0, "case 0: GetY")
assert(self:GetZ() == 0, "case 0: GetZ")
assert(self:GetRotationX() == 0, "case 0: GetRotationX")
assert(self:GetRotationY() == 0, "case 0: GetRotationY")
assert(self:GetRotationZ() == 180, "case 0: GetRotationZ")
assert(self:GetVAlign() == 1, "case 0: align")
SCREEN_WIDTH=800; SCREEN_HEIGHT=600; SCREEN_LEFT=0; SCREEN_TOP=0; SCREEN_RIGHT=SCREEN_WIDTH; SCREEN_BOTTOM=SCREEN_HEIGHT; SCREEN_CENTER_X=400; SCREEN_CENTER_Y=300
self:finishtweening():xy(0,0):z(0):rotationx(0):rotationy(0):rotationz(0):zoom(1):valign(0.5)
self:zoomx(SCREEN_WIDTH / 640):zoomy(SCREEN_HEIGHT / 240):zoomz(-2)
assert(self:GetZoomX() == 1.25, "case 1: GetZoomX")
assert(self:GetZoomY() == 2.5, "case 1: GetZoomY")
assert(self:GetZoomZ() == -2, "case 1: GetZoomZ")
assert(self:GetX() == 0, "case 1: GetX")
assert(self:GetY() == 0, "case 1: GetY")
assert(self:GetZ() == 0, "case 1: GetZ")
assert(self:GetRotationX() == 0, "case 1: GetRotationX")
assert(self:GetRotationY() == 0, "case 1: GetRotationY")
assert(self:GetRotationZ() == 0, "case 1: GetRotationZ")
assert(self:GetVAlign() == 0.5, "case 1: align")
SCREEN_WIDTH=641; SCREEN_HEIGHT=481; SCREEN_LEFT=0; SCREEN_TOP=0; SCREEN_RIGHT=SCREEN_WIDTH; SCREEN_BOTTOM=SCREEN_HEIGHT; SCREEN_CENTER_X=320; SCREEN_CENTER_Y=240
self:finishtweening():xy(0,0):z(0):rotationx(0):rotationy(0):rotationz(0):zoom(1):valign(0.5)
self:x(SCREEN_CENTER_X):y(SCREEN_BOTTOM - SCREEN_CENTER_Y):z(SCREEN_TOP + SCREEN_LEFT)
assert(self:GetZoomX() == 1, "case 2: GetZoomX")
assert(self:GetZoomY() == 1, "case 2: GetZoomY")
assert(self:GetZoomZ() == 1, "case 2: GetZoomZ")
assert(self:GetX() == 320, "case 2: GetX")
assert(self:GetY() == 241, "case 2: GetY")
assert(self:GetZ() == 0, "case 2: GetZ")
assert(self:GetRotationX() == 0, "case 2: GetRotationX")
assert(self:GetRotationY() == 0, "case 2: GetRotationY")
assert(self:GetRotationZ() == 0, "case 2: GetRotationZ")
assert(self:GetVAlign() == 0.5, "case 2: align")
SCREEN_WIDTH=640; SCREEN_HEIGHT=480; SCREEN_LEFT=0; SCREEN_TOP=0; SCREEN_RIGHT=SCREEN_WIDTH; SCREEN_BOTTOM=SCREEN_HEIGHT; SCREEN_CENTER_X=320; SCREEN_CENTER_Y=240
self:finishtweening():xy(0,0):z(0):rotationx(0):rotationy(0):rotationz(0):zoom(1):valign(0.5)
self:zoomx((SCREEN_RIGHT - SCREEN_LEFT) / 160):zoomy(-SCREEN_HEIGHT / 3 + SCREEN_CENTER_Y):zoomz(SCREEN_HEIGHT / SCREEN_WIDTH)
assert(self:GetZoomX() == 4, "case 3: GetZoomX")
assert(self:GetZoomY() == 80, "case 3: GetZoomY")
assert(self:GetZoomZ() == 0.75, "case 3: GetZoomZ")
assert(self:GetX() == 0, "case 3: GetX")
assert(self:GetY() == 0, "case 3: GetY")
assert(self:GetZ() == 0, "case 3: GetZ")
assert(self:GetRotationX() == 0, "case 3: GetRotationX")
assert(self:GetRotationY() == 0, "case 3: GetRotationY")
assert(self:GetRotationZ() == 0, "case 3: GetRotationZ")
assert(self:GetVAlign() == 0.5, "case 3: align")
SCREEN_WIDTH=854; SCREEN_HEIGHT=480; SCREEN_LEFT=0; SCREEN_TOP=0; SCREEN_RIGHT=SCREEN_WIDTH; SCREEN_BOTTOM=SCREEN_HEIGHT; SCREEN_CENTER_X=427; SCREEN_CENTER_Y=240
self:finishtweening():xy(0,0):z(0):rotationx(0):rotationy(0):rotationz(0):zoom(1):valign(0.5)

assert(self:GetZoomX() == 2, "case 4: GetZoomX")
assert(self:GetZoomY() == -480, "case 4: GetZoomY")
assert(self:GetZoomZ() == 3, "case 4: GetZoomZ")
assert(self:GetX() == 0, "case 4: GetX")
assert(self:GetY() == 0, "case 4: GetY")
assert(self:GetZ() == 0, "case 4: GetZ")
assert(self:GetRotationX() == 0, "case 4: GetRotationX")
assert(self:GetRotationY() == 0, "case 4: GetRotationY")
assert(self:GetRotationZ() == 0, "case 4: GetRotationZ")
assert(self:GetVAlign() == 0.5, "case 4: align")
